description: This file is a PHP script that tests the TCPDF library by generating a PDF document with sample content, including headings, lists, tables, images, and text formatting.

classes.name: TCPDF
classes.description: Main class from the TCPDF library used for PDF document creation.

methods.name: SetCreator
methods.description: Sets the creator metadata for the PDF document.

methods.name: SetAuthor
methods.description: Sets the author metadata for the PDF document.

methods.name: SetTitle
methods.description: Sets the title metadata for the PDF document.

methods.name: SetSubject
methods.description: Sets the subject metadata for the PDF document.

methods.name: SetKeywords
methods.description: Sets keywords metadata for the PDF document.

methods.name: SetHeaderData
methods.description: Defines header data such as logo, title, and string.

methods.name: SetMargins
methods.description: Sets the page margins.

methods.name: SetAutoPageBreak
methods.description: Enables or disables automatic page breaks.

methods.name: SetHeaderMargin
methods.description: Sets the margin for the header.

methods.name: SetFooterMargin
methods.description: Sets the margin for the footer.

methods.name: setImageScale
methods.description: Sets the image scale ratio.

methods.name: setHeaderFont
methods.description: Sets the font for the header.

methods.name: setFooterFont
methods.description: Sets the font for the footer.

methods.name: setLanguageArray
methods.description: Sets language-specific strings for the PDF.

methods.name: AliasNbPages
methods.description: Initializes the alias for total number of pages.

methods.name: AddPage
methods.description: Adds a new page to the PDF.

methods.name: SetBarcode
methods.description: Sets a barcode value to be embedded.

methods.name: writeHTML
methods.description: Outputs HTML content into the PDF.

methods.name: Cell
methods.description: Outputs a cell with specified width, height, and content.

methods.name: Output
methods.description: Outputs the PDF document to browser or file.
